name: Ephemeral Sandbox
description: Runs agent-executed code in a throwaway sandbox rather than directly on your machine, so a command that goes wrong takes the sandbox with it and nothing else.
tagline: Run agent code somewhere it cannot hurt you

definition.note: On/off switch for the Core-local wasmtime sandbox tool (sandbox.sandbox_exec). Enabling this plugin makes the sandbox tool available; disabling marks it unavailable. Core-local — no gateway restart.

permission_levels.label: Can run code
permission_levels.description: Execute commands and code inside an ephemeral sandbox on this node.
